summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by NIO Inc., a foreign private issuer, announcing the record date for its upcoming annual general meeting of shareholders. The filing sets the record date as May 22, 2026, for ordinary shareholders and ADS holders to be eligible to attend and vote. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change. The filing is purely administrative and procedural in nature, serving to provide notice of the meeting record date and voting instructions.
